'''Armored Manglerbeast''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A variant of manglerbeasts that evolved specifically on Talos-II. These unique manglers are armored in extremely thick scales and share a mutualistic symbiosis with rockhowlers. The former species provides the bulwark and muscle while the latter offers keen senses and warns against trespassers.}}

==Overview==
The Armored Manglerbeast uses the following attacks.
*Stomps in place several times as the Rockhowler on its back throws a banana peel.
*Stands still as the Rockhowler on its back throws several rocks.
*Roars in place, then charges towards the target before slashing. If it steps on a banana peel while charging, it will slip and fall for a few seconds. While downed, the Rockhowler on its back becomes a weak point and takes much more damage.
*Leaps towards the target three times, each slam creating an increasingly large AoE.
*After a delay, leaps backwards and creates an explosion on landing.
*Pulls a pillar out of the ground and spins it around itself 9 times, before getting dizzy for a period after.
*Curls up and enters a defensive stance that deflects all attacks, creating a large explosion after a charging period. Its hands become a weak point while charging, with doing enough damage to them breaking the stance and causing it to reel for a few moments.
